name: @kitora/commerce
description: Kitora's commerce kit: pricing tables with a billing toggle and comparison matrix, a cart with coupons and tax, a checkout flow with a card field that never stores data, order summaries and invoices, and a Calendly-style booking widget across time zones, on a framework-free core with pluggable adapters.

exports.name: minorDigits
exports.description: How many decimal digits the currency's minor unit has: 2 for USD, 0 for JPY, 3 for KWD.

exports.name: money
exports.description: Money from minor units (rounded to an integer).

exports.name: fromMajor
exports.description: Money from a major-unit number (`fromMajor(19.99, "USD")` is 1999 cents).

exports.name: toMajor
exports.description: The amount in major units, for charts and inputs.

exports.name: zero
exports.description: Zero in a currency.

exports.name: add
exports.description: The sum of two amounts in the same currency; throws when the currencies differ.

exports.name: subtract
exports.description: `a` minus `b` in the same currency; throws when the currencies differ.

exports.name: multiply
exports.description: Multiply by a quantity or factor, rounding half away from zero to whole minor units.

exports.name: percentOf
exports.description: `percent` of a value (`percentOf(m, 8.25)` is 8.25 %), rounded to whole minor units.

exports.name: sum
exports.description: The sum of a list of amounts; zero in `currency` for an empty list.

exports.name: minMoney
exports.description: The smaller of two amounts in the same currency.

exports.name: isZero
exports.description: Whether an amount is zero.

exports.name: intlMoneyFormatter
exports.description: The default formatter: `Intl.NumberFormat` in the given locale, currency style.
exports.signature: (locale?: string, options?: { readonly compact?: boolean; }) => MoneyFormatter

exports.name: Money
exports.description: An amount in the currency's minor unit (cents for USD, yen for JPY). Always an integer.

exports.name: MoneyFormatter
exports.description: Formats an amount for display. Swap it through `CommerceProvider formatter`.

exports.name: planFeatures
exports.description: Every feature of a plan in one shape, `included` resolved (a string, or an object without the flag, is included).

exports.name: priceFor
exports.description: The price shown for a plan on an interval, or null for a custom plan.

exports.name: monthlyEquivalent
exports.description: The per-month figure of a price billed every `interval` (yearly 120 → 10 / mo).

exports.name: yearlySavingsPercent
exports.description: Percent saved by paying yearly instead of 12 monthly payments, rounded down; 0 when unknown.

exports.name: maxYearlySavings
exports.description: The best saving across plans, for the "Yearly · save up to 20 %" toggle label.

exports.name: groupComparison
exports.description: Rows grouped under their headings, in first-seen order; ungrouped rows form one unlabelled group.

exports.name: BILLING_INTERVALS
exports.description: The billing intervals the kit understands. Extend by passing your own label map to the ui.

exports.name: BillingInterval
exports.description: One of {@link BILLING_INTERVALS}.

exports.name: MONTHS_PER_INTERVAL
exports.description: Months per interval: the divisor for the monthly-equivalent price.

exports.name: PlanFeature
exports.description:
One bullet on a plan card. `included: false` marks a feature the plan does NOT have (drawn muted
and struck through, announced as "not included"), so tiers can list the same features side by side.

exports.name: PlanFeatureInput
exports.description: A feature as written in `Plan.features`: a plain string is an included feature.

exports.name: Plan
exports.description: A pricing plan: its name, one price per billing interval, features and card options.

exports.name: ComparisonValue
exports.description: A comparison cell: a tick, a cross, a short text ("10 GB") or a number. `null` = not applicable.

exports.name: ComparisonRow
exports.description: One row of the plan comparison table: a label and one cell per plan id.

exports.name: ComparisonGroup
exports.description: Comparison rows under one heading.

exports.name: emptyCart
exports.description: An empty cart in a currency, with no coupon.

exports.name: clampQuantity
exports.description: Clamp a requested quantity into [1, maxQuantity]; non-integers round down.

exports.name: cartReducer
exports.description: The pure cart reducer. Adding a line whose id is already in the cart adds to its quantity.

exports.name: lineTotal
exports.description: A line's unit price times its quantity.

exports.name: itemCount
exports.description: The number of items in the cart: the sum of every line's quantity.

exports.name: subtotal
exports.description: The sum of every line total, before discount, shipping and tax.

exports.name: needsShipping
exports.description: Does anything in the cart ship? Digital-only carts skip the shipping step.

exports.name: flatTaxPolicy
exports.description: One rate everywhere, optionally per-country overrides, optionally taxing shipping.
exports.signature: (ratePercent: number, options?: { readonly label?: string; readonly taxShipping?: boolean; readonly byCountry?: { readonly [country: string]: number; }; readonly inclusive?: boolean; }) => TaxPolicy

exports.name: couponDiscount
exports.description: The discount a coupon gives on a subtotal, never more than the subtotal.

exports.name: computeTotals
exports.description:
Every figure of the order summary. Order of operations (the one most shops
use): subtotal → coupon discount on goods → shipping (zeroed by a
free-shipping coupon) → tax on the discounted goods (and shipping if the
policy says so) → total. Inclusive tax is reported but not added.
exports.signature: (state: CartState, options?: { readonly shipping?: Money; readonly tax?: TaxPolicy; readonly country?: string; readonly region?: string; }) => CartTotals

exports.name: CartLine
exports.description: One line in the cart: a product (in one variant), its unit price and quantity.

exports.name: COUPON_KINDS
exports.description: The kinds of discount a coupon can resolve to.

exports.name: CouponKind
exports.description: One of {@link COUPON_KINDS}.

exports.name: AppliedCoupon
exports.description: A coupon after validation: what it does, never how it was looked up.

props.name: currency
props.description: ISO 4217 code every amount in the cart is in.

props.name: lines
props.description: The lines, in the order they were added.

props.name: coupon
props.description: The applied coupon, or null when none is applied.

exports.name: CartAction
exports.description: An action for {@link cartReducer}: add or remove a line, set a quantity, apply or remove a coupon, or clear the cart.

exports.name: MIN_QUANTITY
exports.description: The smallest quantity a line keeps; setting below it removes the line.

exports.name: TaxInput
exports.description: Where the tax policy is asked: the taxable goods amount, the shipping charge, and the destination.

exports.name: TaxResult
exports.description: What a tax policy returns: the tax amount, its receipt label, and whether prices already include it.

exports.name: TaxPolicy
exports.description: The tax seam. Default: `flatTaxPolicy`. A host can call its tax provider and feed the result in.

exports.name: NO_TAX
exports.description: No tax at all (B2B reverse charge, tax shown later).

exports.name: CartTotals
exports.description: The cart's money summary: subtotal, discount, shipping, tax, total and item count.

exports.name: digitsOnly
exports.description: Only the digits of a typed value.

exports.name: detectCardBrand
exports.description: The card brand from a number's leading digits, or `"unknown"`.

exports.name: cardBrandLabel
exports.description: The display name of a brand ("Visa", "American Express"); `"Card"` for an unknown one.

exports.name: maxCardLength
exports.description: The longest number the brand allows, for the input's cap.

exports.name: cvcLength
exports.description: How many digits the brand's security code has (4 for Amex, else 3).

exports.name: cardNumberMask
exports.description:
The number's input mask for `useMask` (`@kitora/primitives`), chosen by the leading digits: the brand's groups
up to its longest number (the rest in one last group), one `9` per digit, a space between groups, and `?` after
its shortest number so a 16-digit Visa is complete. It lays digits out exactly as {@link formatCardNumber} does.

exports.name: cardCvcMask
exports.description: The security code's input mask for a brand: one `9` per digit it takes.

exports.name: formatCardNumber
exports.description: Group digits for display ("4242 4242 4242 4242", "3782 822463 10005"), capped to the brand's maximum.

exports.name: luhnValid
exports.description: The Luhn (mod 10) checksum every card number carries.

exports.name: validateCardNumber
exports.description: Check a card number's length for its brand and its Luhn checksum; null when valid.

exports.name: formatExpiry
exports.description: Format typed expiry as "MM / YY" (a leading 2–9 becomes 0M).

exports.name: parseExpiry
exports.description: Parse "MM / YY" into a month and a four-digit year, or null when incomplete.
exports.signature: (value: string) => { readonly month: number; readonly year: number; } | null

exports.name: validateExpiry
exports.description: Expiry validity against `now`: a card is good through the last day of its month.

exports.name: validateCvc
exports.description: Check that a security code has the brand's digit count; null when valid.

exports.name: maskedCard
exports.description: The masked display form: "•••• 4242".

exports.name: CARD_BRANDS
exports.description: The card brands the field detects; `"unknown"` until the leading digits match one.

exports.name: CardBrand
exports.description: One of {@link CARD_BRANDS}.

exports.name: CardSummary
exports.description: What the kit keeps after tokenising: enough to show "Visa •••• 4242", never the number.

exports.name: CARD_EXPIRY_MASK
exports.description: The expiry's input mask, laid out as {@link formatExpiry} writes it (`MM / YY`).

exports.name: CARD_ERRORS
exports.description: Error codes, so the ui maps them to its own words (and a host to its locale).

exports.name: CardError
exports.description: One of {@link CARD_ERRORS}: why a card field is not valid.

exports.name: validateAddress
exports.description: Field-level errors for an address; empty object when valid. Swap through `useCheckout validateAddress`.

exports.name: hasErrors
exports.description: Whether an address error object has any error.

exports.name: formatAddressLine
exports.description: One-line address for review rows ("1 Main St, Austin TX 78701, US").

exports.name: buildInvoice
exports.description: An invoice from an order. Paid orders produce a paid invoice due on issue.
exports.signature: (order: Order, seller: Seller, options?: { readonly number?: string; readonly dueDays?: number; }) => Invoice

exports.name: Address
exports.description: A shipping or billing address, as the checkout form collects it.

exports.name: EMPTY_ADDRESS
exports.description: A blank address with the country set to `"US"`, the checkout's starting value.

exports.name: REQUIRED_ADDRESS_FIELDS
exports.description: Required address fields, in form order.

exports.name: AddressField
exports.description: The name of one address field.

exports.name: AddressErrors
exports.description: Field-level error messages for an address, keyed by field; empty when valid.

exports.name: ShippingOption
exports.description: One shipping choice a shipping adapter quotes: its label, delivery estimate and price.

exports.name: ORDER_STATUSES
exports.description: The states an order moves through.

exports.name: OrderStatus
exports.description: One of {@link ORDER_STATUSES}.

exports.name: Order
exports.description: A placed order: the lines and totals as charged, the address, shipping and card summary.

exports.name: Seller
exports.description: The business that issues an invoice: name, address lines, email and tax id.

exports.name: InvoiceLine
exports.description: One row of an invoice: description, quantity, unit price and amount.

exports.name: Invoice
exports.description: An invoice derived from an order and the seller's details.

exports.name: DEFAULT_DUE_DAYS
exports.description: Days until an unpaid invoice is due.

exports.name: initialCheckout
exports.description: A fresh checkout on the address step, optionally with a prefilled address and the shipping step skipped.
exports.signature: (options?: { readonly address?: Address; readonly skipShipping?: boolean; }) => CheckoutState

exports.name: activeSteps
exports.description: The steps this checkout walks, in order.

exports.name: isStepComplete
exports.description: Is a step's own data complete?

exports.name: canEnter
exports.description: A step is enterable when every active step before it is complete; nothing but confirmation once placed.

exports.name: checkoutReducer
exports.description: The pure checkout reducer. Step moves that would skip an incomplete step are ignored.

exports.name: selectedShipping
exports.description: The chosen shipping option, or null when none is chosen.

exports.name: CHECKOUT_STEPS
exports.description: The checkout steps, in order.

exports.name: CheckoutStep
exports.description: One of {@link CHECKOUT_STEPS}.

exports.name: PaymentMethod
exports.description: The payment the checkout holds: the adapter's token and the card summary, never the number.

props.name: step
props.description: The step shown now.

props.name: skipped
props.description: Steps the flow skips (no shipping step for a digital-only cart).

props.name: address
props.description: The shipping or billing address as typed so far.

props.name: shippingOptionId
props.description: The id of the chosen shipping option, or null before one is chosen.

props.name: shippingOptions
props.description: The options the shipping adapter quoted for the address.

props.name: payment
props.description: The tokenized payment, or null until the payment step is done.

props.name: order
props.description: The placed order, or null until the order is placed.

exports.name: CheckoutAction
exports.description: An action for {@link checkoutReducer}: set data, move between steps, record the placed order or reset.

exports.name: wallTime
exports.description: The wall-clock reading of `epoch` in `timeZone`.

exports.name: zoneOffsetMinutes
exports.description: Minutes the zone is ahead of UTC at `epoch` (−300 for New York in winter).

exports.name: zonedToEpoch
exports.description: The instant a wall-clock time happens in `timeZone`: a time skipped by DST moves forward by the gap, a repeated one takes the earlier instant (the pickers zone core's `compatible` rule).
exports.signature: (date: IsoDate, minutesOfDay: number, timeZone: string) => number

exports.name: parseIsoDate
exports.description: `[year, month, day]` of a plain date; a malformed one reads as 1970-01-01 (booking's dates come from its own grid, never from input).

exports.name: isoDate
exports.description: A plain date from its year, month (1–12) and day.
exports.signature: (year: number, month: number, day: number) => IsoDate

exports.name: isoDateIn
exports.description: The calendar date of an instant in a zone.

exports.name: addDays
exports.description: Shift a calendar date by whole days.

exports.name: weekdayOf
exports.description: The weekday of a plain date, 0 = Sunday.

exports.name: monthGrid
exports.description: Every date of a month, as a calendar grid starting on `weekStartsOn` (null = padding cell).
exports.signature: (year: number, month: number, weekStartsOn?: number) => readonly (IsoDate | null)[]

exports.name: offsetLabel
exports.description: "GMT−05:00"-style label for a zone at an instant.

exports.name: formatInZone
exports.description: Format an instant in a zone with Intl options (cached per locale + zone + options).
exports.signature: (epoch: number, timeZone: string, options: Intl.DateTimeFormatOptions, locale?: string) => string

exports.name: formatIsoDate
exports.description: Format a calendar date (no zone involved): "Tuesday, March 4".
exports.signature: (date: IsoDate, options: Intl.DateTimeFormatOptions, locale?: string) => string

exports.name: IsoDate
exports.description: A calendar date as "YYYY-MM-DD" (no zone).

exports.name: WallTime
exports.description: A wall-clock reading in a zone: date, hour, minute and weekday.

exports.name: monthOf
exports.description: The month a date falls in.

exports.name: addMonths
exports.description: `month` moved by `delta` months (negative goes back), rolling the year.

exports.name: monthsBetween
exports.description: Whole months from `from` to `to` (negative when `to` is earlier).

exports.name: firstOfMonth
exports.description: The first day of a month as an ISO date.

exports.name: openingMonthStep
exports.description:
One step of the opening-month search in booking months: the pickers core's
`firstSlotPageStep` on month pages (stay on a month with a bookable day, page
forward one, or go back to the current month once the next one passes the
horizon or `MAX_AUTO_MONTHS`).
exports.signature: (input: { readonly shown: BookingMonth; readonly hasBookableDay: boolean; readonly today: IsoDate; readonly now: number; readonly timeZone: string; readonly horizonDays?: number; }) => { readonly month: BookingMonth; readonly done: boolean; }

exports.name: availableDates
exports.description: Which dates of a list have at least one slot (for greying calendar days).
exports.signature: (input: Omit<SlotsForDayInput, "viewerDate"> & { readonly dates: readonly IsoDate[]; }) => ReadonlySet<IsoDate>

exports.name: DEFAULT_DURATIONS
exports.description: The meeting lengths most booking pages offer.

exports.name: DEFAULT_STEP_CAP
exports.description: The longest default step between starts: a two-hour meeting still starts on every half hour.

exports.name: hm
exports.description: Parse "09:30" into minutes from midnight.

exports.name: MAX_AUTO_MONTHS
exports.description:
How far the page search goes on its own looking for a page with a slot,
when the host names no month (the opening page) or the invitee asks for the
next available time: a year of months, or a quarter of weeks. Past it the
search gives up (see {@link firstSlotPageStep}).

exports.name: slotsForDay
exports.description:
Bookable slots on `viewerDate` in `viewerTimeZone` (see the file header for
the rules). Walks the host-local dates that can touch the invitee's day (a
day either side covers every offset), steps through each open window, and
keeps the starts that pass every rule, sorted.

exports.name: weeklyHours
exports.description: Weekly hours from a compact map: `{ 1: [["09:00", "17:00"]], ... }`.
exports.signature: (byDay: { readonly [weekday: number]: readonly (readonly [string, string])[]; }) => readonly (readonly TimeRange[])[]

exports.name: windowsOn
exports.description: The host's open windows on one host-local date, as instants (a window across a DST change is as long as the clocks make it).

exports.name: Availability
exports.description: The host's published hours.

exports.name: Interval
exports.description: An interval in epoch ms, end exclusive.

exports.name: Slot
exports.description: One bookable slot. `id` is the start as a string, stable across reloads.

props.name: id
props.description: The slot's start in epoch ms as a string; stable across reloads, so it can key a list or a selection.

props.name: remaining
props.description: Seats still free (1 for a one-to-one meeting).

props.name: start
props.description: Start of the interval, in epoch ms (included).

props.name: end
props.description: End of the interval, in epoch ms (excluded).

exports.name: SlotRules
exports.description: How bookable slots are cut from availability: the meeting length, the step between starts, buffers and notice.

exports.name: TimeRange
exports.description: Minutes from local midnight, start inclusive, end exclusive: 540–1020 is 09:00–17:00.

exports.name: BookingMonth
exports.description: A calendar month, `month` 1–12: the page a booking calendar shows.

exports.name: DAY_PARTS
exports.description: Morning / afternoon / evening by the viewer's local hour, for a grouped grid.

exports.name: DayPart
exports.description: Which part of the day a slot falls in: `"morning"`, `"afternoon"` or `"evening"`.

exports.name: BookingRequest
exports.description: What the invitee asks for: the slot, its length in minutes, their name, email, notes and time zone.

exports.name: ConfirmedBooking
exports.description: A booking the adapter accepted: the request plus its id and an optional location.

exports.name: isCommerceError
exports.description: Whether a thrown value is a `CommerceError`, so a catch block can read its `code`.

exports.name: errorMessage
exports.description: A message for any thrown value.

exports.name: COMMERCE_ERROR_CODES
exports.description: Every code a `CommerceError` can carry, so the ui maps each to its own words.

exports.name: CommerceErrorCode
exports.description: One of {@link COMMERCE_ERROR_CODES}: why an adapter call failed.

exports.name: CommerceError
exports.description: The one error type adapters throw; `code` is a closed set, `message` is for the user.

exports.name: CouponAdapter
exports.description: The coupon seam: checks a typed code against the cart and returns its resolved effect.

exports.name: ShippingAdapter
exports.description: The shipping seam: quotes the shipping options for an address and cart.

exports.name: CardDetails
exports.description: What the card field hands the payment adapter ONCE. The kit never stores it.

exports.name: PaymentAdapter
exports.description: The payment seam: turns card details into an opaque token once, so the kit never keeps the number.

exports.name: OrderDraft
exports.description: Everything the order adapter needs to place an order: the cart, its totals, address, shipping and the payment token.

exports.name: OrderAdapter
exports.description: The order seam: places an order from a draft and returns the placed order.

exports.name: BookingAdapter
exports.description: The booking seam: loads the host's availability and books a slot.

exports.name: CommerceAdapters
exports.description: Everything a full storefront needs. Each part is optional where the ui can do without it.

exports.name: fakeCoupons
exports.description: A fake coupon service that knows {@link FAKE_COUPONS} and rejects unknown, expired and below-minimum codes.

exports.name: fakeShipping
exports.description: Flat-rate carrier table; express is free over $200, international costs more.

exports.name: fakePayments
exports.description: A fake payment service that returns a random token and declines {@link FAKE_DECLINED_CARDS}.

exports.name: fakeOrders
exports.description: A fake order service that places orders as paid with rising numbers (from #1042 unless `firstNumber` is given).
exports.signature: (latencyMs?: number, options?: { readonly firstNumber?: number; readonly clock?: () => number; }) => OrderAdapter

exports.name: createFakeCommerce
exports.description: Every storefront adapter, faked.

exports.name: fakeBooking
exports.description:
A booking service with a deterministic busy pattern (some slots already
taken each day, so the grid looks lived-in) that remembers what was booked
and rejects a double booking with `slot-taken`.
exports.signature: (options?: { readonly latencyMs?: number; readonly availability?: Availability; }) => BookingAdapter

exports.name: FAKE_LATENCY_MS
exports.description: Default simulated round trip.

exports.name: FAKE_COUPONS
exports.description: The codes the fake coupon service knows.

exports.name: FAKE_DECLINED_CARDS
exports.description: Test numbers that decline, as with real payment sandboxes.

exports.name: FAKE_AVAILABILITY
exports.description: A host in New York with weekday hours, a long lunch on Fridays, and a holiday override.

exports.name: localTimeZone
exports.description: The viewer's IANA zone from Intl.

exports.name: supportedTimeZones
exports.description: Every zone the runtime supports, or the common list.

exports.name: localLocale
exports.description: The viewer's preferred locale, or undefined (Intl then uses its default).

exports.name: FALLBACK_TIME_ZONE
exports.description: Fallback when the runtime cannot tell (SSR, locked-down browsers).

exports.name: COMMON_TIME_ZONES
exports.description: A short list for runtimes without `Intl.supportedValuesOf`.

exports.name: digitsBefore
exports.description: How many digits sit before `position` in `value`.

exports.name: positionAfterDigits
exports.description: The index in `formatted` just after its `count`-th digit.

exports.name: reformatInput
exports.description:
Reformat an input in place with `format` and restore the caret after the
same digit. Returns the formatted value for the caller's state.

exports.name: CARD_NUMBER_ATTRS
exports.description: Attributes for a card-number input that never persists its value.

exports.name: CARD_EXPIRY_ATTRS
exports.description: Attributes for a card expiry input: browser autofill as `cc-exp`, a numeric keypad, no spell check.

exports.name: CARD_CVC_ATTRS
exports.description: Attributes for a card security-code input: browser autofill as `cc-csc`, a numeric keypad, no spell check.

exports.name: useControllableState
exports.description: State that is controlled when `value` is given and kept inside otherwise; `onChange` fires in both modes.
exports.signature: <T>(options: { readonly value?: T; readonly defaultValue: T; readonly onChange?: (next: T) => void; }) => readonly [T, (next: T | ((prev: T) => T)) => void]

exports.name: CommerceProvider
exports.description: Optional: swap the money formatter, the locale or the clock for every part below.

props.name: formatter
props.description: Formats every amount; without it, `Intl.NumberFormat` in `locale`.

props.name: locale
props.description: The locale for amounts, dates and times.

props.name: now
props.description: The clock, in epoch milliseconds; pin it in a test or demo.

props.name: children
props.description: The commerce parts that read these settings.

exports.name: useCommerceSettings
exports.description: The settings from the nearest `CommerceProvider`, or the defaults (en-US, `Date.now`) without one.

exports.name: useMoneyFormat
exports.description: `format(money)` with the provider's formatter.

exports.name: CommerceSettings
exports.description: The display settings every commerce part reads: the money formatter, the locale and the clock.

exports.name: usePricing
exports.description: Pricing-page state: the billing interval and, per plan, the price, monthly figure and yearly saving.
exports.signature: (options: UsePricingOptions) => { readonly interval: "month" | "year"; readonly setInterval: (next: "month" | "year" | ((prev: "month" | "year") => "month" | "year")) => void; readonly plans: readonly PlanView[]; readonly maxSavings: number; }

exports.name: PlanView
exports.description: One plan as shown for the chosen interval: its price, monthly figure and yearly saving.

exports.name: UsePricingOptions
exports.description: Options for {@link usePricing}; the `PricingTable` takes the same props.

exports.name: useCart
exports.description: Cart state with its totals, line actions and the async coupon flow.

exports.name: UseCartOptions
exports.description: Options for {@link useCart}.

exports.name: CartApi
exports.description: What {@link useCart} returns.

exports.description: The card field's state: typed values, brand, per-field errors and `tokenize()`, which sends the digits once and wipes them.
exports.signature: (options: UseCardFieldOptions) => { readonly values: { readonly number: string; readonly name: string; readonly expiry: string; readonly cvc: string; }; readonly brand: "unknown" | "visa" | "mastercard" | "amex" | "discover"; readonly setField: (field: CardFieldName, raw: string) => void; readonly touch: (field: CardFieldName) => void; readonly errorFor: (field: CardFieldName) => string | null; readonly valid: boolean; readonly pending: boolean; readonly submitError: string | null; readonly tokenize: () => Promise<PaymentMethod | null>; readonly reset: () => void; }

exports.name: CARD_FIELDS
exports.description: The card field's inputs, in form order.

exports.name: CardFieldName
exports.description: One of {@link CARD_FIELDS}.

exports.name: CARD_ERROR_MESSAGES
exports.description: Default words for each error code; override through `messages`.

exports.name: UseCardFieldOptions
exports.description: Options for {@link useCardField}.

exports.name: CardFieldApi
exports.description: What {@link useCardField} returns.

props.name: month
props.description:
The month on screen, controlled; pair it with `onMonthChange`. With no `month`, `defaultMonth`,
`date` or `defaultDate`, the calendar opens on the first month that still has a bookable day
(31 October with no slots left opens on November), looking up to `MAX_AUTO_MONTHS` (12) ahead
and no further than `rules.horizonDays`. A named month, or a date's month, always wins.

props.description: The month to open on, uncontrolled; turns the first-bookable-month search off.

props.name: onMonthChange
props.description: Called when the month on screen changes, with the new month.

props.name: rules
props.description: Slot rules besides the duration (step, buffer, notice, horizon).
